title: GIVEN
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

session.instruction: Encourage someone who's weary this Advent — tell them one specific way you're grateful for them and one reason you have hope for them.

coaching_notes: Advent means "coming" or "arrival." This is the time to prepare your heart for the celebration of Christ's birth at Christmas. Let encouragement be part of your preparation.
